title: The Coaching Experience: Edition II
body: Project-managed a live coaching showcase end to end. I ran the 12-week timeline, coordinated 17 coaches plus hosts and sponsors, built the 12-tab master dashboard and the run-of-show, and wrote a playbook so the next edition runs on a repeatable process. Delivered July 30, 2026.

title: Cheat Code Scanner
body: A terminal tool that logs button presses and counts how often a combo like "DD" shows up. Same idea as searching for text inside a dataset.

title: Boss Battle
body: A terminal RPG from MIT 6.0001 (lectures 1 to 3): you attack a dragon and its health bar drains hit by hit. My first build that ties loops, conditionals, and string work together.
